name: How long does water damage repainting take?

mainEntity.name: How long does water damage repainting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of water damage repainting varies significantly based on the extent of the damage, the size of the affected area, and the drying time required. Minor water spots might take a day or two for preparation and painting. More severe damage involving drywall replacement, mold remediation, and multiple coats of specialty primer and paint could extend to several days or even a week. The drying period for water-damaged materials before painting is often the most time-consuming part of the process, typically taking several days to ensure no moisture remains.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repainting time depends on damage severity and drying time, ranging from a couple of days for minor issues to a week or more for extensive damage.
